# Introduction

This vignette shows how to use the JobPlacementData package.  
The package includes a dataset called `placement` and several functions  
for cleaning, summarizing, plotting, and modeling the data.

# Load the package

```r
library(JobPlacementData)

cleaned <- clean_placement(placement)
head(cleaned)

# Base R scatterplot
plot(cleaned$IQ, cleaned$CGPA,
     main = "Base R: IQ vs CGPA",
     xlab = "IQ",
     ylab = "CGPA",
     pch = 19, col = "steelblue")

# Base R barplot
placement_counts <- table(cleaned$placement_binary)
barplot(placement_counts,
        main = "Base R: Placement Outcome",
        names.arg = c("Not Placed", "Placed"),
        col = c("tomato", "seagreen"))

library(lattice)

xyplot(CGPA ~ IQ | internship_binary,
       data = cleaned,
       main = "Lattice: CGPA vs IQ by Internship Completion",
       xlab = "IQ",
       ylab = "CGPA",
       pch = 19, col = "darkorange")

library(ggplot2)

ggplot(cleaned, aes(x = IQ, y = CGPA, color = factor(internship_binary))) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "ggplot2: CGPA vs IQ with Trend Line",
       color = "Internship")
